title: Coordinate Geometry
subtitle: Understanding the Cartesian Plane
subject: Mathematics
author: Antigravity AI
learning_outcomes: Plot a point in the plane if its coordinates are given.
Identify the coordinates of a point in a given Cartesian plane.
Understand quadrants, origin, axes, abscissa, and ordinate.

ai_context.learning_goal: To give students a solid understanding of how to map a 2D space using X and Y axes.
common_misconceptions: Confusing the x-coordinate with the y-coordinate when plotting points.
Thinking that the origin (0,0) belongs to a specific quadrant.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Always remind students that the first number in the coordinate pair (x, y) refers to horizontal movement, and the second refers to vertical movement.
